subject: maths
question: At what annual rate of interest will a sum of money be thrice in 5 years at simple interest?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal amount (P) = 100 (assuming)

Simple Interest (SI) = 200 (since the amount becomes thrice, i.e., 3P - P = 2P)

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

**Calculation:**

SI = (P × R × T) / 100

⇒ 200 = (100 × R × 5) / 100

⇒ 200 = 5R

⇒ R = 200 / 5

⇒ R = 40

**The annual rate of interest is 40%.**
